groupings.description: 筛电 Filtmall / Filtalgo 官方购物 Skill：中国电商高性价比商品搜索、按预算筛选、同款同规格价格比较与购买。Cost-effective shopping in Chinese e-commerce: product discovery, budget filtering, evidence-based price comparison, checkout, orders and after-sales on Filtmall.
